domains.setupTitle: How to connect your domain (3 steps)
domains.step1Desc: Click "Add domain" and enter the domain you purchased (e.g. blog.mysite.com).
domains.step2Title: Add 2 DNS records at your registrar
domains.step2Desc: Go to your DNS provider (Cloudflare, GoDaddy, Namecheap…) and add these 2 records:

domains.hostingerTip: Using Hostinger? Hostinger does not allow a CNAME at the root (@). Instead, add a redirect from your root domain to www, then add only the CNAME for "www" and the TXT verification record.
